newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - FACTORS TO WATCH - AUG 8.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - FACTORS TO WATCH - AUG 8.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Friday:
* On Thursday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 71.31 points or 0.86 percent to close at 8188.00, dragged by a weak bond market.

* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index plunged 23.41 points or 2.46 percent to 928.33 on selling of big-cap stocks following the recent series of market-negative developments from trade deficit to capital controls.
* Ringgit quoted at 2.6440/70 a dollar at around 0049 GMT, flat from 2.6455/85 at its Kuala Lumpur ending on Thursday.
